sharedDirection: One distinct square service photograph; candid smartphone salon portfolio photography in South Africa; warm welcoming natural light, natural skin texture, realistic anatomy, soft background blur, modest working salon; different activity, angle or arrangement; no lettering, logos, watermarks, collage or borders.

Close view of a therapist's hands gently massaging exfoliating scrub over the calf and ankle of an adult dark-skinned woman. Leg supported on a folded white towel, bright natural window light, modest salon.
